question: Which of the following five year plan of India commenced at a time when the global economy was going through a second financial crisis?
solution: The correct answer is __**Twelfth**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The **Twelfth Five-Year Plan** of India was from **2012 to 2017**. • It commenced during a period when the **global economy was recovering from the second financial crisis**, which occurred in **2008-2009**. • The plan focused on achieving **“Faster, Sustainable, and More Inclusive Growth.”** • During this time, India faced challenges such as **global economic slowdown**, inflation, and high fiscal deficit. • The Twelfth Plan emphasized sectors like **healthcare, education, infrastructure, and energy** to strengthen the economy amidst global uncertainties.
